data.name: 0000_same_silver_surfer.sql
data.summary: Initial Drizzle migration that creates the baseline local SQLite schema for accounts, categories, incomes, expenses, expense scheduler, sync meta, mutation queue, conflicts, and app settings.

data.name: accounts
data.summary: Mirror of the Notion Accounts database: stores account identity, type, starting balance, credit metadata, and Notion edit tracking.

data.name: app_settings
data.summary: Generic key/value table for app-level settings and small persistent flags.

data.name: conflicts
data.summary: Records three-way merge conflicts (base/local/remote per field) detected during sync, with resolution metadata.

data.name: expense_categories
data.summary: Mirror of Notion expense categories, including monthly budget and auxiliary flag used for workflows.

data.name: expense_scheduler
data.summary: Recurring expense templates that generate expense rows on schedule, with frequency, next-run date, and active flag.

data.name: expenses
data.summary: Mirror of the Notion Expenses database with payment tracking, pasabuy fields, credit-card linkage, and soft-delete support.

data.name: income_categories
data.summary: Mirror of Notion income categories with source label and auxiliary flag.

data.name: incomes
data.summary: Mirror of the Notion Incomes database with gross/capital split, transaction-account linkage, and credit-card payment coverage.

data.name: mutation_queue
data.summary: Outbox queue of pending local mutations awaiting push to Notion, with attempts and last-error tracking.

data.name: sync_meta
data.summary: Generic key/value table used by the sync layer to track cursors, last-run timestamps, and configuration flags.

data.name: 0001_kind_nekra.sql
data.summary: Adds pasabuy payment date and paid-period columns to the expenses table to support pasabuy installment tracking.

data.name: 0002_add_account_qr_code.sql
data.summary: Adds a qr_code text column to the accounts table to store an optional account QR code reference.

data.name: 0003_reflective_angel.sql
data.summary: Creates the activity_log table that records sync actions and lifecycle events for the History page.

data.name: activity_log
data.summary: Per-record activity log capturing resource, action, direction, title, and Notion page id for sync events.

data.name: 0004_massive_maximus.sql
data.summary: Adds a run_id column to activity_log so log entries can be grouped under a single sync run identifier.

data.name: 0005_chat.sql
data.summary: Creates the chat agent tables: chat_credentials, chat_threads, and chat_messages, with supporting indexes for thread and message lookup.

data.name: chat_credentials
data.summary: Stores chat provider credential metadata (name, key fingerprint, default flag) while secrets remain in safeStorage.

data.name: chat_threads
data.summary: Stores chat conversation threads with title, credential, model, and overlay selection plus timestamps.

data.name: chat_messages
data.summary: Append-only message log for chat threads, with role, content, optional structured payload JSON, and created timestamp.

data.name: 0006_chat_drafts.sql
data.summary: Creates the chat_drafts table for durable, confirm-gated proposals that survive app restarts until the user Approves or Cancels.

data.name: chat_drafts
data.summary: Durable store of chat-proposed creates/updates with status, missing required fields, warnings, payload, target ids, and a computed preview.

data.name: 0007_chat_draft_display.sql
data.summary: Adds a presentation-only display column to chat_drafts so the confirm card can show resolved names and amounts instead of raw ids.

data.name: 0008_reference_icons.sql
data.summary: Adds an icon column to accounts, income_categories, and expense_categories to cache Notion page icons locally (data URIs or emoji).

data.name: 0009_activity_payload.sql
data.summary: Adds a payload column to activity_log so the History page can render full read-only form modals for synced income and expense items.
